_comment: ADR-023 THE FOSSIL LAW. Grandfathered dead symbols, keyed file|kind|symbol (NOT line - lines move). THIS LIST ONLY SHRINKS. 'count' and 'ceiling' are the ratchet's witnesses: the probe FAILS if either disagrees with 'fossils', so a hand-edit cannot pass quietly. --write-baseline can only ever remove entries. New entries enter ONLY via --grandfather --reason=<text>, which records provenance in grandfather_log.
